verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a built-in Automations scheduler. It persists jobs, wakes the agent at the right time, and delivers output to a chat channel, a webhook, or nowhere. It also supports webhook, Gmail PubSub and IMAP triggers, plus standing orders that give autonomous programs permanent operating authority. One community user also reports scheduling tasks across 9 agents. Missing for 10: in-depth independent hands-on corroboration of reliable unattended background runs; details on failure handling and monitoring of scheduled jobs.
